user.title: BLE IRK Extractor
user.description: Point the integration at the BlueZ bond data on your Home Assistant host. {path_help}

data_description.name: Friendly name for this extractor.
data_description.copied_path: Folder containing BlueZ info files copied into Home Assistant. Default: /config/bluez_irks.
data_description.host_path: BlueZ host storage. Default: /var/lib/bluetooth. Leave blank if this path is not available in the container.

data_description.setup_anyway: Finish setup even though no keys are present yet. The sensor will update automatically when keys appear.
